title: Biomimetic multi-layer scaffolds with aligned polyurethane nanofibers and tailored hyaluronic acid/gelatin hydrogels for sustained methylprednisolone release in potential cardiovascular applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,231-245
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08241B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Reyhaneh Farshbaf Shakib, Masoumeh Haghbin Nazarpak, Atefeh Solouk, Saeid Bahrami
A multi-layered 3D scaffold combining aligned electrospun polyurethane nanofibers and HA–gelatin hydrogels enhanced porosity and mechanical properties. It enabled controlled methylprednisolone release and supported HUVEC attachment and viability.
